22480971-eb7a-4b4e-ab41-4b1495d985ed.text:
问：嘉宾是谁？
答：Zuo Li — guitarist and Hua Chenyu's best friend since Super Boy 2013. He joins the matinee unplugged segment.

c896154a-ed06-4dd3-ab01-79ab8f091941.text:
问：日场和晚场区别？
答：One ticket grants entry to both. The matinee is unplugged and relaxed; the evening show is the full rock live narrative.

38cdf66f-45d1-4b9c-a12c-0e4915022aab.text:
问：在哪里购票？
答：Official platforms: Damai, Maoyan, Ctrip and Douyin. Four tiers: ¥380 / ¥680 / ¥980 / ¥1280. One ticket covers both shows.

77d6f4ce-8d27-4838-9fac-0d9fdfd7f80d.text:
问：演出时间地点？
答：September 25–27 and October 2, 3, 5, 6, 2026 — seven shows — at Nanjing Tangshan Music Valley, a 400,000 ㎡ abandoned quarry.

8150e361-81f3-4ef8-b1a7-2195573be1f6.text:
问：是全站票吗？
答：Yes — an all-standing rock festival format. Wear comfortable shoes and arrive early to claim your spot near the stage.

751b8732-05cc-4430-a6b7-4305f5e6c1a7.text:
问：什么是双生歌单？
答：Two complete setlists, each with its own narrative arc, mirroring each other at the core and alternating across the seven shows.

d22691a5-39db-4628-b5e1-c036d2a22507.text:
《火星演唱会2025退票政策》
1. 开票后7天内且距演出30天以上退票，免手续费；
2. 距演出10-30天退票，收取票价20%手续费；
3. 距演出48小时-10天退票，收取50%手续费；
4. 演出前48小时内不支持退票；
5. 电子票已核销（已入场）不支持退票；
6. 退票原路退回，1-7个工作日到账。
